phase: DEV-250 River Development Agent Controlled Executor Operation Preparation Foundation
commitMessage: DEV-250: Build River Development Agent controlled executor operation preparation foundation
architectureStatus: Generation III controlled executor operation preparation foundation
predecessor: DEV-249 River Development Agent controlled executor operation admission foundation
objective: Create a deterministic controlled executor operation-preparation foundation that consumes a trusted ready admitted DEV-249 operation and derives an explicit immutable preparation record describing the admitted operation, inherited authorization provenance, authorized capability evidence, approved execution scope, and required downstream execution constraints without performing the operation, modifying repository state, or granting additional authority.
architecturalDecision: DEV-249 establishes operation admission but performs no execution.
DEV-250 introduces a preparation boundary after admission and before any future controlled operation execution.
Preparation may describe an admitted operation but may not perform it.
Preparation cannot create new capability authorization.
Preparation cannot expand approved execution scope.
Preparation cannot transform an unadmitted operation into an executable operation.
Repository mutation, shell execution, commit, push, deployment, secret access, autonomous execution, and scope expansion remain downstream and separately governed.

Operation preparation requires governed execution-request evidence.
Operation preparation requires authorized capability evidence.

Operation preparation preserves the required capability.
Operation preparation preserves authorization provenance.
Operation preparation preserves approved execution scope.
Operation preparation is deny-by-default.

Operation preparation cannot expand approved execution scope.
Operation preparation cannot perform shell execution.

Operation preparation cannot delete repository state.
